basis: Plasmalogen biosynthesis disorder with defining neurologic disease; early cataracts occur in most reported patients (>80%).

decisions.ocular: involved: early cataracts are characteristic structural eye disease, reported in >80% of affected patients.

basis: Skeletal glycosylation disorder with defining developmental impairment (6/9); dental defects in 10/10. Severe hearing loss (30-79%) omitted at cap.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: structural dental abnormalities affect 10/10; retained for their near-universal frequency within the four-axis cap.
decisions.neurologic: primary: delayed mental and motor development defines the syndrome; global developmental delay occurs in 6/9.
decisions.otologic: none: severe sensorineural hearing loss qualifies at 30-79%, but is omitted at cap in favor of universal skeletal/dental and major neurologic disease.

basis: Mitochondrial/peroxisomal metabolic disease defining encephalopathy; optic atrophy is variable, without an established >=30% frequency across this umbrella.

decisions.ocular: none: optic atrophy is variably reported; neither a >=30% frequency across the umbrella nor a required diagnostic criterion is established.

basis: Complex I metabolic defect; developmental/structural brain disease, seizures 2/3; pulmonary arterial hypertension 2/2 and skeletal muscle atrophy 1/2.

decisions.neurologic: involved: severe developmental impairment and brain atrophy are common; seizures occur in 2/3. The concept is defined by complex I deficiency.

basis: Ovarian signet-ring metastasis usually originates in the gastrointestinal tract; tumour-origin rule supports gastrointestinal. Ovary and breast have no axis.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: most Krukenberg tumours originate in stomach or bowel; the tumour-origin rule applies despite the defining ovarian metastatic site.

basis: Subcutaneous, intestinal and upper-airway edema are defining disease sites. Bradykinin-mediated C1-inhibitor deficiency is neither autoimmune disease nor immunodeficiency.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: upper-airway edema is explicitly a defining site; the exclusion for transient additional manifestations does not remove a defining disease site.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: hereditary C1-inhibitor deficiency causes bradykinin-mediated edema, without defining infection, immunodeficiency or autoimmune/immune-mediated disease.

basis: Defining skeletal, urinary and anorectal defects; hydrocephalus/cortical atrophy 80-99%. Cap omits lung hypoplasia (80-99%), ear, eye, hepatic and cardiac findings.

decisions.pulmonary: none: lung hypoplasia/aplasia qualifies at 80-99%, but is omitted at cap to retain core skeletal, renal and anorectal defects plus severe CNS disease.
decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: anal atresia and rectovesical fistula are defining malformations; anorectal and intestinal anomalies have HPO frequency 80-99%.

basis: Defining neurodevelopmental disease; strabismus affects 4/5. Flat feet/joint laxity (3/5) lack demonstrated functional injury; constipation alone does not establish gut damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: pes planus and joint hypermobility occur in 3/5, but neither documented skeletal injury nor impaired musculoskeletal function is established.

basis: Autoimmune systemic sclerosis with defining lung and skin fibrosis; intrinsic gastrointestinal fibrosis/dysmotility affects >50%. Vascular disease omitted at cap.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: skin sclerosis is a defining manifestation and major diagnostic criterion of systemic sclerosis, including its pulmonary form.

basis: Deglycosylation defect with defining neurodevelopmental disease and alacrima (12/15); characteristic hepatic injury with elevated transaminases in 8/11 (~73%).

decisions.ocular: primary: impaired tear production is a cardinal defining feature, with alacrima in 12/15 and documented corneal opacity.
